approval_reference: AskUserQuestion 2026-10-18 ~10:10Z, option "Amendment A3 quy nguyen nhan (Recommended)": frozen versioned external-attribution amendment A3 + one final stage-100

classes.EXTERNAL_SESSION_INTERRUPTION: a session-type G9 loss (TRADE_SESSION_UNVERIFIED / EXECUTION_CONTEXT_NOT_EXECUTION_ELIGIBLE) whose onset lies between the lane's last good frame and its first venue fault, writer workers LIVE and local/DL-path checks clean from the onset to restoration, restored within recovery_budget_s counted from the outage start
classes.EXTERNAL_SESSION_UPSTREAM: the SAME venue event (channel, symbol, venue id) on a fresh connection was on time (<= probe_healthy_ms) while the production lane received it >= lane_late_margin_ms later
classes.EXTERNAL_VENUE_RESET: a G4 event in flight across a complete VENUE-originated session-fault episode of its own lane (OKX cause EOF/CLOSE_FRAME/READ_ERROR/HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT/NOTICE*, Binance peer reset/close or heartbeat failure; no DL-initiated end such as STALENESS_HANDOVER/BOOK_RESYNC/WRITE_ERROR or connect failure in the episode)
classes.EXTERNAL_VENUE_WIDE: NOT assigned in v1: a late fresh probe can be the probe's own scheduling on this host and no probe-side scheduler evidence is recorded (review finding 1)
classes.UNKNOWN: anything else, including a different probe event in the same second (supporting only), missing coverage, retention overflow, an ambiguous lane: counts as FAIL

conditions.caps: per G4 row AND per window: EXTERNAL units <= max_external_fraction x the admitted samples (so a p95 failure, >= 5 % of a window over the limit, is never rescued); G9: EXTERNAL losses <= max_external_fraction x demanded x readable samples and <= max_external_episodes_per_venue episodes per venue; any recovery > recovery_budget_s -> FAIL
conditions.clock: host clock bound sampled every 30 s by the A3 sampler; samples within clock_bracket_s on both sides of the unit, each <= host_clock_bound_ms
conditions.internal_segments: G4: Kafka CreateTime - DL receipt <= row limit receive_to_canonical_ms, observer receipt - CreateTime <= canonical_to_consumer_ms, receipt->observer total <= the row limit; G9: core raw_age and gateway dispatch lag within limits over the recovery seconds
conditions.lane_timeline: last good frame (progress last_frame_age), fault event (heartbeat_failed / disconnected / connect_failed), first frame of a newer generation (progress), eligibility restoration (writer heartbeat, ~30 s resolution); canonical coordinate and consumer ACK per event are not recorded and replaced by the DL-path checks and the restoration sample
conditions.local_checks: the ingestor of the unit: cgroup throttled periods 0, worst thread run-queue wait <= limit, no socket sample with unread bytes, continuous coverage (gap <= 2 s) and no sampler error; samples ~100 ms apart cannot exclude a shorter stall nor frames read into user space but processed late (stated, not over-claimed); another lane of the same ingestor reading (progress interval after each fault)
conditions.retention: EXTERNAL units stay in every distribution and in the receipt (count, durations, recovery); verdicts are recomputed on the remaining units with the unchanged thresholds
conditions.same_event_or_same_seconds: probe evidence joins on the venue id DL keeps as source_sequence; lane faults on the event's/slice's own lane in its seconds (+- reset_pad_s)

inherits.note: amendments 1 and 2 (files unchanged) are re-pinned to gate_campaign_tool.new_sha256

limits_sources.note: per-row internal limits from the addendum's frozen baseline run only (never a candidate); OKX inverse rows use their pooled OKX row

pinned.note: old = at the pre-amendment base ref, new = frozen with this amendment; the scorer applies A3 (and amendments 1/2 through it) only when the campaign tool sha256 equals gate_campaign_tool.new_sha256

scope.G2: latency tails: in scope, but NO G2 unit is attributable in this version: the native writer's slices carry no per-sample receive/canonical/dispatch clock and the Python MARK records have envelope_received_at NOT_MEASURED (Query reference basis); every G2 tail is UNKNOWN = FAIL as before (reported with the lane episodes)
scope.G4: a failing row-window (frozen-table p95 rule or GATED addendum max rule) is re-scored when every ADMITTED event above the row limit is retained (observer v7, no overflow, the window maximum among them) and EXTERNAL; amendment 1's row keeps its own rule; REPORT_ONLY rows unchanged
scope.G9: data-path eligibility losses only; demanded == session-ready, v1 fallback and internal-caused losses stay strict

inherited_not_rerun.G12: PASS on the final image set (inherited)

scope.old_receipts: immutable: a campaign that did not record this file's sha256 at run time scores exactly as before (053803Z / 135719Z / 074624Z / 092255Z); the invalid 092255Z receipt is kept

stop_rules: one declared run (a NEW run after the invalid 092255Z, not its infrastructure rerun)
exact-client smoke failure, unresolved A1 allowance or a preflight problem: refused, no load
an apparatus fault in the client (ImportError/NameError/SyntaxError) aborts the driver at once
a foreign job before or early in the load window (guard TAINTED): one rerun allowed (infra fault)
any other failure is a result: no rerun until green
runtime images must equal runtime_images below (else A3 is not applied and scoring is strict)

workload.client_smoke: target-matrix (exact client image, mounts, user, bootstrap) before any load
